_doc: Room-unique relics for the three rooms added in data/hall/building_v3.json: the walk-in freezer off the kitchen, the staff room off the back corridor, and the cage room off the cellar. Each is hidden in one room spot ('unique') and nowhere else.

relics.name: The Hook from the Cold Room
relics.desc: Cold steel that never warms. Every fight opens with the cold in them: every enemy is slowed for a round, and heroes' melee hits on slowed targets deal +3.

relics.name: Margaret's Ring, in Ice
relics.desc: Still on the finger. The finger is still cold. Once a turn, a hero who takes a hit grows a skin of frost: 1d4+2 temporary HP.

relics.name: HELLO MY NAME IS ____
relics.desc: A staff badge, the name scratched out so hard the pin bent. He can't put a name to your face: he watches 15% less, and cheats add 20% less to the FILE.

relics.name: A Mug: WORLD'S BEST
relics.desc: The rest of the slogan has been worn off by a thumb. Every sip, a random hero gets a bonus action and the FILE drops 1.

relics.name: Ball Number One
relics.desc: The first number he ever called. It's warm. It has always been warm. Heroes can't roll a natural 1.

relics.name: Head, MK IV
relics.desc: One of his old faces. It turns when you aren't looking. Start every fight with a 17 up your sleeve, and he looks away 15% longer, listening for it.
